page.layout: One printed page. Top: woodcut ornament (not text). Below it: title block in roman capitals and roman type, centred. Then running text in roman and italic, with a large woodcut initial D at the start of the paragraph. Page number "§ 2" at the foot right. No margin notes. Manuscript ink mark at top left is not printed.

main_text.head: REVERENDO, NOBILISSIMO, ET SPECTATISSIMO VIRO, DOMINO FRANCISCO MARESCALLO, Reuerendi Capituli Bremensis Decano honoratissimo, Præpositoq; ad Portam cœli dignissimo, Domino & Patrono suo multum honorando, salutem a Domino IESV precatur.
main_text.p: DVPLEX hominum de Philosophia male sentientium genus, Reuerende, nobilissime, ac spectatissime Domine Decane, Patrone plurimum honorande, Reipublicæ Christianæ insigniter pernitiosum esse opinor. Primum genus dico eorum, qui propter pauca, quæ in libris paganorum Philosophorum, a decretis & sanctitate nostræ religionis

page.notes: The title block is set in mixed roman capitals and roman type; the opening words "DVPLEX" and "VPLEX" are set in small capitals with the initial D as a woodcut letter, transcribed as D plus VPLEX. Some words are overprinted by red ink marks and are partly obscured; the transcription follows the legible letters. The first two words of the paragraph are in small capitals.
